name: Home Assistant — Entities
description: A status grid of several Home Assistant entities — six Bauhaus / Swiss visual directions to choose from. Each row tints by its state (on / off / other) and shows its current value. Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: overrides
cell_options.label: Custom names + icons
cell_options.help: One row per ticked entity. Leave the name blank to keep the auto label; pick "No icon" to keep the auto icon.
